purpose: Frozen JUNE-2026-vintage SYNIO index, used only by Replay A (the regression gate). Distinct from and independent of test/fixtures/replay/manifest.json's index (the CURRENT/September SYNIO snapshot, used by Replay B, the drift report) — the two are never mixed. Shape mirrors manifest.json's `index` object (project/root/storage) so the harness's prepareWorkdir()/resolveFrozenDbPath() can be reused unmodified against either index.
provenance_search: Searched the filesystem broadly (find over /, /mnt/c, and ~) for any nca.db dated May-June 2026 before reconstructing, per task instructions to prefer a real existing copy over reconstruction. Found /mnt/c/dev/synio/.nca/nca.db and several worktree copies with June mtimes, but none had verifiable provenance: NCA's schema does not record which exact synio commit or which NCA build produced a scan (file_index only stores per-file mtime/sha256, no commit hash), so I could not confirm any of them matched 'last synio commit <= 2026-06-26, scanned by NCA build 95d52b4' with certainty. Reconstructing from a known commit + known build gives 100% verifiable provenance, so that was preferred over an unverifiable pre-existing file.

index.synio_commit_message: chore(rls): remove dead withRLS helper with unsafe signature
index.synio_commit_selection: last synio commit at or before 2026-06-26 (the baseline corpus's temporal_range.latest), via `git log -1 --until=2026-06-26T23:59:59`.
index.note_on_commit_message: This commit's own subject line references removing an RLS helper — directly adjacent to the withRLSContext anomaly under investigation. Not interpreted or acted on here; Replay A (empirical replay against this exact index) is what resolves whether that anomaly is drift or regression, not reading this commit's diff.

nca_build_used_to_scan.commit_message: feat(corpus): orientation event extractor from Claude Code corpus (#52)
nca_build_used_to_scan.selection: last NCA commit at or before 2026-06-26 (same criterion as the synio commit) — also the reference build for Replay A itself.

scan.scanned_at: 2026-09-15 (today — the DB's CONTENT reflects the June synio commit; the scan necessarily runs at reconstruction time, migration_log timestamps reflect that, not June)

storage.rule_applied: size >= 5MB threshold -> stored OUTSIDE the repo (same rule as the September index)
storage.permissions: chmod 444 (read-only) — the harness copies it into a per-run tmpdir before ever opening it, same pattern as the September index.
storage.does_not_touch: test/fixtures/replay/manifest.json's frozen September index (~/.nca/replay/synio-frozen.db) is untouched by this file or by Replay A.
